about.title: About Brinkmann Quality Roofing Services
text: Don’t fall for the “storm chaser” roofers who play insurance games, give dodgy repairs (or unneeded replacements!), and ditch Houston before accountability can catch them. Trust Brinkmann Roofing to deliver prompt storm damage repairs and guide you through a simple, no-nonsense storm insurance claims process from start to finish.

At Brinkmann, we offer top-quality roofing solutions to Houston homeowners, business owners, and property managers. Every service below reflects our commitment to precision and our deep understanding of what Greater Houston properties need.

Our half-century of experience and commitment to quality ensure that YOUR Houston roofing project meets our sky-high standards. From new roof installation on construction builds to full roof replacement on aging systems, we handle every detail. Our residential team specializes in asphalt shingle, architectural shingle, and fortified roofing systems designed for the Houston climate.
